data.case_title: Unterhaltsvorschuss (advance maintenance) granted for daughter Marie
data.title: Unterhaltsvorschuss granted for your daughter Marie (€293.00/month)
data.summary: The Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück (Jugendamt, Unterhaltsvorschusskasse) notifies that it will pay Unterhaltsvorschuss (advance child maintenance) of €293.00 per month for the daughter Marie starting 1 November 2026. The authority itself will pursue the maintenance claim against the father.
data.explanation: The youth welfare office (Jugendamt) has approved a monthly advance maintenance payment of €293.00 for Marie, starting 1 November 2026, because it covers the minimum maintenance minus full child benefit. You must immediately tell them if the father pays maintenance directly to you or if you move. If you disagree with the decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch); the app shows the deadline for this once it is calculated. If you take no action, the decision as described here stands and payments continue as stated.

items.title: Receive the monthly Unterhaltsvorschuss payment
items.action: No action is needed; the advance maintenance payment is credited automatically each month.
items.quote: für Ihre Tochter Marie zahlen wir ab dem 01.11.2026 Unterhaltsvorschuss nach dem Unterhaltsvorschussgesetz in Höhe von 293,00 € monatlich.

items.title: File an objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree with the decision
items.action: If you disagree with the decision, submit a written objection (Widerspruch) to the Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück, or declare it in person for the record at their office.
items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe des Bescheids bei uns eingehen (Kreisverwaltung Musterhunsrück, Schlossplatz 7, 55469 Musterbach im Hunsrück); Sie können ihn schriftlich einreichen oder bei uns zur Niederschrift erklären.

items.title: Report if the father pays maintenance or if you move
items.action: Immediately inform the Jugendamt if the father pays maintenance directly to you, or if you change your address.
items.quote: Teilen Sie uns bitte sofort mit, wenn er Unterhalt an Sie zahlen oder Sie umziehen.
